decisions.delayed_static_hoists: No GPU extension: modeled physical refresh count increases (251 to 259 without batching; 288 to 304 with batching).
decisions.threshold_and_capacity_sweep: No GPU extension: lowest modeled physical count is 246 versus 251 at the current threshold, while logical refresh work grows. This does not support a large further saving.
decisions.ready_priorities: No GPU extension: ordering ready nodes by produced depth or operation cost leaves the modeled physical refresh count at 251 in all five variants.
decisions.coefficient_aware_polynomial_depth: No GPU extension: simulating the existing vector evaluator reduces the depth bound for 108 batches, but increases modeled physical refreshes from 288 to 295 under this scheduler. A smaller local depth does not guarantee better global refresh batching.
